Quality control

Flag problem wells, blank-correct and smooth growth curves.

flag_od_range()
Flag wells with saturated or negative OD
blank_correct()
Blank-correct OD
smooth_od()
Smooth growth curves with a centered rolling mean
flag_no_growth()
Flag wells whose blank-corrected signal never rises
